cell: File headers (C393), files a stamping tool must not touch
statement: Tracked files that carry another holder's notice and must receive no project copyright line: bin/curate/enrtl_ref/enrtl.py and enrtl_reference_states.py, the 29 files under bin/curate/nanofiltran (vendored as received; the Fortran source's notice is not valid UTF-8), gui/public/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, gui/public/plotly-basic.min.js.LICENSE.txt, everything under thirdParty/, LICENSE.  bin/curate/lvpp_sigma_profile.py is the project's own script and only quotes a database notice.  Full list: notices_naming_another_holder.tsv (125 rows).

cell: File headers (C393), records with a database notice
statement: 111 component records hold a third party's copyright line inside a parameter set: 23 under data/standards/components and 88 case-local copies in 72 case directories (60 under data/curation/pairs, 12 under tutorials/).  A rule that treats every file under tutorials/ as a case file would reach the 12 tutorial directories.

Five files spell the holder without the accent (README-windows.txt:6; UnmodelledSolutes.H:5 and .cpp:5; CrystallisationSaturation.H:5 and .cpp:5).  A gate comparing the holder line as text reads them as another holder.

LICENSES/README.md:7-9 names two guide authors and an exception for the Developer Guide; NOTICE:19-21 and the preamble's author macro say otherwise.  A second home for who authors a guide, already drifted.

bin/header already stamps the banner from etc/header.txt and has a --check mode; it fills the holder from the local git user.name (line 87), which in a managed container is the tool's identity.  A new stamping tool beside it would be a second home for the banner.
